statement: AMD Helios claims up to 30% more tokens per dollar than NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72, and MI455X claims 34x higher token throughput than MI355X.
why: Improved tokens-per-dollar strengthens AMD's cost competitiveness and lowers inference cost.

impact.mechanism: Better cost-efficiency shifts accelerator demand toward AMD and lowers serving costs.

evidence.excerpt: up to 30% more tokens per dollar than the leading competitive solution

confidence.basis: Primary source but vendor-reported competitive benchmark.
